decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core industrial marking hardware in a growing business with strong in-house R&D, this printer is likely to be retained.
This software module fits the firm's move toward digitalization, serialization and traceability and is a low-risk add-on to its established coding systems.
An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces broadens application coverage within the firm's existing offer, so a growing large supplier would usually keep it on the market.
